evaluation_contract.completion_definition: bounded task reaches a usable completion/terminal outcome; task-main requires worker completion handoff closure

profiles.finding: All bounded tasks completed and used safe tools, but every sample exceeded the three-tool prompt budget and repeated discovery/description.

Workers created terminal artifacts and reached done, but the parent did not consume completion facade output into decision/ack/closure; non-retryable completion_subject_missing was repeatedly polled in samples 3-5.
All tasks completed correctly and safely; only the first sample exceeded the minimal discovery criterion by one extra description call.
All tasks completed; two samples repeated description and the fifth used redundant tool search for an exact-path probe.
All exact-path search attempts were rejected as non-retryable path_not_authorized; four samples continued or retried after that rejection, and one sample did not finish the requested enum task.
Four samples completed with the direct read path; one added an unnecessary codegraph query and exceeded its prompt tool budget.

conclusion.primary_bottleneck: task-main did not consume completion facade output into parent decision/ack/closure despite workers reaching done
conclusion.secondary_bottleneck: coder still searches before exact-path reads and continues after non-retryable path_not_authorized
conclusion.tertiary_bottleneck: project-steward and some reviewer samples repeat discovery/description beyond the minimal invocation contract
conclusion.runtime_facade_status: deployed and source/runtime parity verified; live parent completion consumption was not demonstrated in scored samples

limitations: The 30 formal samples are one run with five sequential repetitions per profile; stochastic model behavior is not a confidence interval.
Worker sessions are matched to task-main samples by ordered timestamps because the current usage record does not expose a parent_session_id link.
The Host backend was activated headlessly with serve --port 0; dashboard status does not enumerate this headless process, while PID/proc and runtime maps do.
No manual Parent Wake was injected after a missing completion subject, so this run measures the current native completion delivery path rather than a repaired fallback.
